name: Subject and Time: Jean-Luc Marion’s Alteration of Kantian Subjectivity.
headline: Subject and Time: Jean-Luc Marion’s Alteration of Kantian Subjectivity.
description: The article focuses on the works and contribution of philosopher Jean-Luc Marion particularly his alteration of Kantian subjectivity, a philosophy of German philosopher Immanuel Kant which deals with the position of mind, epistemology, and ethics.
